rationale: Fire damage to the claimant's own kitchen cabinets, ceiling, and walls caused by an accidental grease flare-up on the claimant's own stove; this is direct damage to the claimant's property covered under property_damage.
claim_summary: Claim for POL-1001 (Alex Doe, active homeowners policy, $500 deductible, $250,000 coverage limit). Kitchen fire on yesterday evening caused by grease flare-up while cooking; claimant extinguished fire with fire extinguisher. Damage includes charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. No damage to rest of house. Classified as property_damage with high confidence (0.95) and medium severity due to multiple affected surfaces and restoration needs, though fire was contained and no injuries occurred.

rationale: Water damage to the claimant's own property caused by a burst internal plumbing line in their home, resulting in damage to flooring, drywall, and stored items—this is straightforward property damage covered under homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Policyholder: Sam Patel (POL-1004, homeowners premium, active). Incident: Burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink caused basement flooding while claimant was on work trip for approximately two days. Damage includes approximately two inches of standing water across entire basement, buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall to one-foot height, and ruined stored boxes. Coverage: Property damage with $500 deductible and $750,000 limit. Classification: Property damage (confidence 0.95). Severity: High—significant restoration and replacement costs anticipated. Claim ready for adjuster assessment and damage estimation.
